neet_phy_u15_t01_1.working: Only an accelerated charge produces time-varying fields that radiate. Static charges, uniform motion and steady currents do not radiate.

neet_phy_u15_t01_3.working: For a perfect reflector, P = 2I/c = 2(900)/3e8 = 6e-6 N/m^2.

neet_phy_u15_t01_4.working: Speed = 1/sqrt(μ0ε0) (III). Average energy density = ½ε0E0² (IV). Intensity = ½ε0cE0² (II). Momentum to an absorbing surface = U/c (I).

neet_phy_u15_t01_5.working: A is true: frequency is unchanged. B is false: E0/B0 = v, the speed in the medium, not c. C is true: the electric and magnetic energy densities are equal. D is false: EM waves are uncharged and are not deflected by a magnetic field. E is true: reflection gives 2U/c. So A, C and E.
